verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduled workflows are a fair question for a SaaS recruiting platform, so the axis applies. However, the only scheduling evidence covers one-off interview scheduling with candidates, which is a different capability from a recurring job or workflow schedule. Outreach campaigns are not documented as recurring scheduled automations, so nothing in the pack shows the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
